data.narrative:
Altara is an AI & Software company founded by Eva Tuecke and Catherine Yeo at an undisclosed stage. The relevant comp universe spans the AI & Software sector, which includes one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private peers. The five most prominent private comparables are Palantir, Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition.

Standard peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. A search for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables within the AI & Software sector yielded fewer than three datapoints in each category, falling short of the minimum threshold required for reliable median derivation. While 12 same-sector peers exist broadly, the narrow filters necessary to control for stage and scale maturity produced insufficient data density. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable heterogeneity and obscure rather than clarify valuation.

Without stage disclosure, capital raised, or current valuation for Altara, and given the inapplicability of peer-median triangulation, no quantitative valuation range can be supported by the available data. A credible analysis would require either (1) clarification of Altara's funding stage and prior round sizes, enabling stage-cohorted peer selection; (2) identification of additional same-stage or same-tier comparables; or (3) access to revenue, growth rate, or unit economics to support alternative valuation frameworks. The heterogeneity of the AI & Software sector and Altara's undisclosed parameters currently preclude reliable quantitative synthesis.
